bullets.text: Q3 CR improved 8 points from Q2 to 92.4 (YTD 97.2; goal 96); Personal Lines CR was 91.2; Commercial Lines CR 99.1; Property CR 88.2, down about 37 points, largely reflecting lower catastrophe losses.
Companywide NPW +20% for Q3 and YTD; PL NPW +23% to $12.7B; CL NPW +7%; Property NPW +16% to ~$725M (+17% YTD to $2.1B).

Companywide PIF rose 10%. Personal Lines PIF reached 25.5 million (+11%); personal auto PLE grew about 8%. Commercial Lines PIF rose 7% and PLE fell about 9%. Property PIF exceeded 3.0 million, up 7%.
Personal auto rate level rose about 4 points across 25 states in Q3 (about 16 points YTD). Commercial auto non-TNC rates increased nearly 12% YTD. Property rate level rose over 9 points YTD.

Prior year reserve development was unfavorable by 0.2 points in Q3 (2.7 points YTD). Personal auto severity rose about 5% with stable frequency. Commercial auto prior year development contributed 3.8 points.

Catastrophe losses contributed 18 points to Property CR vs 35 points in Q3 2022. Recorded about $23 million in reinsurance recoveries (3.6 points). Began non-renewal effort of up to 115,000 Florida property policies.

Portfolio returned -0.2% (fixed income -0.1%, equity -3.1%); cash and Treasuries allocation increased; debt-to-total capital below 30%; no debt maturities until 2027; cautious approach maintained for December variable dividend.

Economic slowdown and challenging freight conditions reduced for-hire transportation premiums. Commercial auto industry loss trends outpaced premium growth. Small business market indicators remained mixed; motor carrier market exits negatively affected PLE.
Launched BOP in two new states, reaching 43 states; added online buy capabilities via BusinessQuote Explorer; offered heavy truck roadside assistance in 46 states (~92% of eligible vehicles).

Partnered nationally with Family Promise for employee volunteering across 200+ affiliates; continued Humble Design support; provided employee temporary housing after Hurricane Idalia; reinforced Golden Rule core value in customer service.
